scenarios.name: load-seq16
scenarios.description: Load: NO, GRID RECORDING, then for each of the 16 tracks (TRK + TRIG n) a trig on all 16 steps, GRID RECORDING off, PLAY. The sequencer then starts a note on every track at every step. PLAY is at +676M instructions, and the run ends 8 s after it.

scenarios.name: load-turns
scenarios.description: Load: NO, the SRC page (button 2), Trig 1 held from +50M, then each encoder A..H in turn: 40 detents up and 40 down, one detent every 1M instructions (640 turns). The run ends 1 s after the last turn.

scenarios.name: load-ptn-switch
scenarios.description: Load: NO, then 8 pattern changes while stopped (PTN + TRIG 2..8, then TRIG 1), one every 66M instructions (0.5 s). Each change loads that pattern's kit. The run ends 1 s after the last change.

scenarios.name: load-kb-roll
scenarios.description: Load: NO, keyboard mode on (button 18), then a roll over the 13 trig keys that play a note (all but 1, 4 and 8, which start no note in keyboard mode): a key down every 1M instructions (about 130 notes a second), each held 4M, for 792 notes. About 4 keys are down at a time. The run ends 1 s after the last note.
